title: Creation Studio Capability Profile Schema
description: Portable, read-only capability contract published BY the separate CAM-Creation-Studio product and consumed by CAM Assist. Direction is strictly CAM-Creation-Studio -> CAM Assist (inbound publication, informational). The profile declares what Creation Studio is capable of AUTHORING -- not what has been authored, approved, or executed. CAM Assist references it for informational display, request compatibility checking, and documentation only; never for execution decisions. It is the complement of the CAM Assist Creation Studio Request (CAM-A22): together they form a bidirectional information exchange over a strictly one-way flow of authority. The profile is descriptive and advisory: it does not authorize execution, does not request execution, does not bypass human review, does not confirm machine readiness, does not validate machining, does not approve strategies, and never requires CAM Assist to use any declared capability. No capability implies approval. It introduces no CAM-Creation-Studio runtime dependency and carries no created_at (the artifact is deterministic and reproducible; regeneration is byte-identical). The capability vocabulary is deliberately OPEN (pattern-constrained identifiers rather than a closed enum) because Creation Studio owns its own capability evolution; compatibility rests on stable identifiers plus semantic versioning. Structural validation does not require declared documentation references to exist (existence is an opt-in completeness concern).

record_version.description: Semantic version of the capability profile record FORMAT (owned by this schema).

profile_version.description: Semantic version of the PUBLISHED CAPABILITY SET, owned by CAM-Creation-Studio. Independent of the CAM Assist version and of record_version: Creation Studio increments it as its authoring capabilities evolve.

studio_reference.description: Identifies the CAM-Creation-Studio installation/version this profile describes. One profile per installation/version; a profile is never package-specific.

publication_direction.description: Must be 'creation_studio_to_cam_assist'. Publication is one-way; no authority returns upstream and no execution request is ever expressed.

capabilities.description: Non-empty list of declared authoring capabilities. NOTE: uniqueItems only rejects wholly identical entries; vanilla JSON Schema cannot express uniqueness by object property, so full capability_id uniqueness is enforced by validate_creation_studio_capability_profile.py. A declared capability records support only -- it is not an approval, an endorsement of any strategy, or a statement about any particular package.

capability_id.description: Stable machine identifier: lowercase alphanumeric plus underscores, starting with a letter. Deliberately pattern-constrained rather than enumerated so Creation Studio can evolve its capability set without a CAM Assist schema change. Once published, an identifier is never renamed (renaming is a breaking change requiring a profile_version major bump).

display_name.description: Optional human-readable name for display. Informational; non-blank when present.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the declared capability. Informational; non-blank when present.

documentation_reference.description: Optional reference to Creation Studio documentation for this capability. Relative path only (no absolute or drive-rooted path); resolved relative to the profile file's own location. Navigational only: the referenced file is never owned, copied, or mutated, and its existence is not required for structural validity.

authority.description: Informational authority constraints. REQUIRED on a capability profile. Every flag MUST be true.

is_informational.description: MUST be true. This record is informational only.

does_not_authorize_execution.description: MUST be true. This record does not authorize machine execution.

does_not_bypass_human_review.description: MUST be true. This record does not bypass required human review.

does_not_confirm_machine_readiness.description: MUST be true. A declared capability does NOT assert that any package is machine-ready.

does_not_require_capability_use.description: MUST be true. Declaring a capability does not require, oblige, or pre-select CAM Assist to use it. Capability selection is never automatic.
